thread:
Aaron R: quick heads-up — i'm going to land a small terraform change that rewrites the ExternalSecret key template for orders-service creds. it fixes a mismatch between vault kv v2 paths and what the k8s consumer expects. planning to push in ~15m unless anyone objects.
Mira K: can you paste the diff? want to eyeball the template because staging mounts the projected secret volume overnight.
Aaron R: sure — gist of the change: 
```hcl
resource \"external_secret\" \"orders_creds\" {\n  provider = {\n    name = \"vault\"\n    path = \"secret/data/orders/creds\"\n    template = \"{{ .Data.data.username }}:{{ .Data.data.password }}\"\n  }\n  target = \"orders/credentials\"\n}\n```
old template used `.Data.username` which fails for kv v2. this just switches to `.Data.data.*` and adds an explicit key mapping so the mount path is now `orders/credentials` (a single key with JSON).
Rohan S: ok that part makes sense. question: will this trigger a full rotate/refresh in staging? we saw pods restart last time when key shape changed.
Aaron R: good point — i added an annotation to gate reconciliation while we validate: `externalsecret.redwood.com/pause-reconcile: \"true\"` on staging before apply, then flip for canary namespace. rollout plan in PR.
Sarah P: pinging ops team — @Rohan S is the oncall for the window but we need to be sure rotation won't hit payment workers. Rohan, can you confirm a 1h window starting 11:30 UTC is ok?
Rohan S: 11:30 UTC works for me. i'll monitor logs and KV cache evictions. if we see >1% 5xx in orders-svc i'll rollback. also add `reconcileTimeout` on the ExternalSecret so it doesn't hammer vault during initial sync.
Aaron R: added `reconcileTimeout = \"30s\"` to the TF resource in the branch. also included a small migration script to backfill old key format to the new single JSON key for existing secrets.
Mira K: can you attach the migration script here? quick scan pls — i can run it in a staging job.
Aaron R: pasted below: 
```bash
# run from CI runner with VAULT_TOKEN
for s in \$(vault kv list -format=json secret/data/orders | jq -r '.[]'); do\n  v=\$(vault kv get -format=json secret/data/orders/\$s);\n  username=\$(echo \$v | jq -r '.data.data.username');\n  password=\$(echo \$v | jq -r '.data.data.password');\n  vault kv put secret/data/orders/\$s creds=\"{\\\"username\\\":\\\"\\\$username\\\",\\\"password\\\":\\\"\\\$password\\\"}\"\ndone
```
CI Bot: PR #4287 — tf: externalsecret orders key-template rewrite (tests: 12/12 passed) — https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4287 :white_check_mark:
DevOps Bot: applied `externalsecret.redwood.com/pause-reconcile=true` to staging/orders namespace (dry-run false)
Sarah P: looks good. Mira, can you run the migration in staging once PR merges? i'll be watching the canary at 11:30.
Mira K: yup will run the backfill as a k8s Job in staging and share logs. if everything is green i'll unpause reconcile in staging for a <10-min smoke.
Aaron R: thanks all. i'll merge in 10 and tag the rollout. will add a short postmortem block in #incidents if anything weird shows up. :thumbsup:
Rohan S: cheers — i'll keep an eye on latency + auth errors during the window. ping me if you want me to run a manual pod restart for quicker eviction.
Mira K: noted — will also run `kubectl describe` on projected volumes to confirm the key is present.
Aaron R: merged. PR link in thread: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4287
CI Bot: Deploy pipeline started for infra/terraform (plan -> apply).
Aaron R: closing this thread — follow-ups in the PR and staging job logs.
